title: Scene Saving causes owner property to save itself recursively
body: ### Tested versions Error appears in: v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] Not observed in 4.5 stable ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7688) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900KF CPU @ 3.60GHz (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory ### Issue description When saving a scene with 3 nodes in sequence, the third node will save an Object() to its owner property. 1. **I am not assigning to owner in the editor** a project wide search for owner results in 0 hits. 2. It does so recursively, the stored owner tries to store its owner, and so on. 3. The file hits 2.5~mb and then stops due to a recursion limit. ### Steps to reproduce Uncertain. My classes for these 3 nodes all extend the same base class, provided below: My going theory is that the existence of the owning scene and sequence properties is causing a recursive lookup, which is expected. However. 1. This should be a finite amount of iterations, simply reaching to the top node in the scene. 2. This should be be invoked during scene saving, since the properties are not exported. 3. These properties are currently **not used**, so despite the class being in tool mode, they are not accessed by me. ```gdscript @tool @abstract @icon("uid://bfiuv58vp11tv") class_name NylonEditorBaseNode extends Node ## A unique ID for this node. ## Used to reference nodes within the scene data var node_uid: String: get: return _node_uid @export_storage var _node_uid: String = NylonIDGenerator.naive_sha1() ## The scene that owns this node currently in the open editor. var owning_scene: NylonEditorScene: get = get_owning_scene ## The sequence that owns this node currently in the open editor. var owning_sequence: NylonEditorSequence: get = get_owning_sequence ## Recursively search the parent node for the scene. func get_owning_scene() -> NylonEditorScene: if self is NylonEditorScene: return self var p: Node = get_parent() if p is NylonEditorBaseNode: return p.owning_scene return null ## Recursively search the parent node for the sequence func get_owning_sequence() -> NylonEditorSequence: if self is NylonEditorScene: return null if self is NylonEditorSequence: return self var p: Node = get_parent() if p is NylonEditorBaseNode: return p.owning_sequence return null ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) -
